result.title: HostileReview tables are mapped in McpDbContext but no migration creates them in any provider
result.summary: McpDbContext declares five HostileReview DbSets (HostileReviewRequests and its ArtifactLink, Execution, Finding, and Diagnostic children), but no migration in QBrainAi.Storage.SqliteMigrations, QBrainAi.Storage.PostgreSqlMigrations, or QBrainAi.Storage.SqlServerMigrations (nor the legacy QBrainAi.Storage/Migrations) contains a CreateTable for any HostileReview table, so a database brought up by migrations lacks them and the hostile-review service would fail at its first query (inference: not observed at run time).
